pages.title: Chronon Capacitor
pages.text: A container for chronons, the speculative quanta of time. If time comes in discrete ticks, those ticks can be stored and released, and this is the vessel. It pulses irregularly, slightly out of step with my own heartbeat, and it is wise to handle it before you use it, never after.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Chronon Field Inverter let Tachyon Flux soak into a Tachyon Crystal, with a Qubit to count the ticks. Paradox Echoes drop charged ones; I took that as a sign the idea was sound before I proved it.
